turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on clothes, colours and sizes?
turns.tutor:
Let me show you how I find a clothes word from a clue. The clue: you wear them on your hands when it is cold. I think: hands, cold, so gloves. I spell it: g-l-o-v-e-s. Then I use it: "The clown wears yellow gloves."
Watch the order of the colour. Right: "a red dress" Wrong: "a dress red". The colour comes first.
Now you try. Write the question again, correctly:
Correct this question: "How much cost this hat?"
